title: Protobuf: rewrite parser of *.proto file from Bison to Lemon
description:
In order to avoid Bison's compatibility problem (as https://code.wireshark.org/review/#/c/33771/ or issue #16924 says, **"This doesn't work with Berkeley YACC, and I'd *really* prefer not to require Bison."**),
the *.proto file parser is rewritten with lemon. (rename `protobuf_lang.y.in` to `protobuf_lang_parser.lemon`)
Also improved the mechanism of recording line number of Protobuf message, field, and enum names.

I have test this patch including testing the examples from
- [Protobuf wiki page](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/wikis/Protobuf) 
- [gRPC wiki page](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/wikis/gRPC)
- add missing fields with default values issue #17000
- negative enum value and numeric option value issue #16988
- dissecting protobuf fields as wireshark fields feature issue #16209
- message/enum types leading dot feature issue #16118 (I found this feature is failed because of involving the code of issue #16988. This bug has been fixed by changing the `"[a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9_.+-]*"` to `"[a-zA-Z0-9_.][a-zA-Z0-9_.+-]*"` in protobuf_lang_scanner.l)

All above examples or cases works fine now.

Note that before opening the sample captures, you should setup *'Protobuf search paths'* and *'Protobuf UDP message types'* preferences according to the description of each example or issue.
